name: Gold and Dagger
source:
As Prince of Szolnia, Zephyr plays an important role in his kingdom’s yearly celebration. Other than celebrating, he hopes to reunite with his longtime friend, the king, with his guard at his side.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
作为索尔尼亚的王子，泽菲尔在王国每年的庆典上都肩负着重任。除了参加庆祝，他还希望能在护卫陪伴下，与相识已久的好友——国王重逢。

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]］
